title: Step 5c - Data Viz in R: Colorizing Pixels for Logistic Regression

cues.en: Instructor: So for those of you who are interested in knowing how the code works, stay with me I will explain that.
cues.zh: 對程式運作有興趣的人，繼續看，我來解釋。

cues.en: So I will reduce this, okay.
cues.zh: 先縮小圖形。

cues.en: And let's explain this.
cues.zh: 現在說明。

cues.en: Okay. So the idea is that we consider each of this pixel observation point as a user in the social network, like an imaginative user.
cues.zh: 想法是，把每個像素觀測點視為社群網路中的假想使用者。

cues.en: And so for example this pixel point here is not a user in the data set but we imagine this pixel point here as a user who has this salary and this age.
cues.zh: 例如這個像素不是資料集真正的人，但想像他有這個薪資、這個年齡。

cues.en: And we apply our classifier on this pixel observation point on this user here.
cues.zh: 對這個像素、這位假想使用者，套用分類器。

cues.en: So that the classifier predicts if the user is going to buy yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 預測他會不會買 SUV。

cues.en: Then once the classifier makes its prediction it colorizes the pixel observation point according to the prediction.
cues.zh: 預測後，就依結果替像素上色。

cues.en: So if the prediction is no this pixel user won't buy the SUV then it will colorize in red.
cues.zh: 如果預測不買，就塗紅。

cues.en: And if the prediction is yes this pixel user will buy the SUV then it will colorize the points in green.
cues.zh: 如果預測會買，就塗綠。

cues.en: And so we applied that idea on all the pixels in this frame so that eventually our classifier will colorize all the points that he predicted as zero in red
cues.zh: 將想法套用到框內全部像素，最後所有預測 0 的點是紅色，

cues.en: and all the points that he predicted as one in green.
cues.zh: 所有預測 1 的點是綠色。

cues.en: So now that you get the idea, let's look at our code here and go through the steps of completing this idea.
cues.zh: 理解概念後，看看程式如何完成。

cues.en: Okay, so first I declare a set equals training set.
cues.zh: 先宣告 set=training_set。

cues.en: That's because I want to plot this graph for the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 因為要分別畫訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And since we're using training set many times in the code I just replaced it by set here.
cues.zh: 程式多次用到 training_set，所以先統一改用 set。

cues.en: So that's when I copy paste the same code for the test set.
cues.zh: 等到複製相同程式給測試集時，

cues.en: I just need to replace test set by training set only here and not in the whole code.
cues.zh: 只需在這裡把 training_set 改成 test_set，而非整段都改。

cues.en: So basically that's just a shortcut.
cues.zh: 這只是捷徑。

cues.en: And so first we build a grid with X1 and X2.
cues.zh: 先用 X1 和 X2 建立網格。

cues.en: So we take the minimum of the values of the training set minus one because we don't want the points to be squeezed in the graph and same for the maximum plus one.
cues.zh: 從訓練資料最小值減 1，到最大值加 1，避免點擠在邊緣。

cues.en: So by doing this, we're taking the range of our training set observation points, minus one and plus one so that our points are not squeezed in the graph.
cues.zh: 所以使用觀測範圍，兩端各外加 1，讓圖面保留空間。

cues.en: And so we're doing this for the age column of the training set and the salary column of the training set.
cues.zh: 對年齡欄與薪資欄分別這樣做。

cues.en: Then by writing this line, we are building the grid.
cues.zh: 接著這一行建立網格。

cues.en: So basically with these three lines, we're making the grid here with all the pixel observation points that are imaginary social network users.
cues.zh: 這三行合起來，建立包含所有假想使用者像素點的網格。

cues.en: Then since this grid set is actually a matrix of the two columns, age and salary, but for all the imaginary users that are the pixel observation points,
cues.zh: grid_set 是兩欄矩陣，年齡與薪資，涵蓋所有像素假想使用者，

cues.en: this is actually a matrix.
cues.zh: 因此它是矩陣。

cues.en: So with this line, we just give a name to the columns of this matrix, which are age and estimated salary.
cues.zh: 這一行替兩個欄位命名為 Age 與 EstimatedSalary。

cues.en: And then that's where all the magic happens.
cues.zh: 接著就是關鍵。

cues.en: Because here that's where we use our classifier to predict the result of each of the pixel observation points
cues.zh: 用分類器預測每個像素觀測點，

cues.en: that are the imaginary pixel users.
cues.zh: 也就是假想使用者。

cues.en: So we predict this and then since the predict function returns to probabilities we transform it into one or zero result.
cues.zh: predict 傳回機率，所以再轉成 1 或 0。

cues.en: So that's why I call it wide grid because it's the predictions of all the points in the grid.
cues.zh: 因此命名為 y_grid，代表網格所有點的預測。

cues.en: So that returns to vector of predictions of all the points in the grid and then finally we plot the whole graph.
cues.zh: 得到全部格點的預測向量後，最後畫完整圖形。

cues.en: So in this plot we include all our real users and their real actions.
cues.zh: 圖中放入所有真實使用者與真實行為。

cues.en: Red if they didn't buy the car, green if they bought the car.
cues.zh: 沒買車是紅色，買車是綠色。

cues.en: And we plot the predicted results of all the pixel observation points that we created when we created the grid.
cues.zh: 再畫出建立網格時，那些像素觀測點的預測結果。

cues.en: So that's here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: And so I'm using the color spring green.
cues.zh: 我使用 springgreen 顏色。

cues.en: So that is the spring green color and tomato that is the tomato color.
cues.zh: 這是春綠色，tomato 是番茄紅。

cues.en: And for the real points, I just use a green four which is a color in R and red three.
cues.zh: 真實點則使用 R 的 green4 和 red3。

cues.en: So this color is green four, and this color is red three.
cues.zh: 這個是 green4，這個是 red3。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就是如此。

cues.en: That's the idea behind this code.
cues.zh: 這是程式背後的想法。

cues.en: It's totally fine if you didn't understand some things in this code because anyway, we're going to use this code as a template for our next classifiers and so we'll just have to copy paste this code.
cues.zh: 有些程式不理解也沒關係，之後分類器會把它當模板，只需複製貼上。

cues.en: But that's all.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: So that was just for those of you who are interested in coding, who are interested in how we can use code to make such a plot.
cues.zh: 這是給對寫程式、如何畫這種圖有興趣的人看的。

cues.en: But the important thing to understand here is that the logistic regression is a linear classifier which in two dimensions means that it's a linear separator
cues.zh: 重點是，邏輯斯迴歸為線性分類器，二維中是直線分隔，

cues.en: and therefore it can miss some predictions like the predictions here, they are incorrect.
cues.zh: 因此有些預測會漏掉，例如這些是錯誤。

cues.en: All right, so thank you for watching this R tutorials, and congratulations.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看 R 教學，也恭喜你。

cues.en: Now you know how to implement a logistic progression model using R.
cues.zh: 現在知道如何用 R 實作邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: You're going to see that we will meet some more powerful classifiers later in our journey.
cues.zh: 旅途中還會遇到更強大的分類器。

cues.en: So I look forward to continue this journey.
cues.zh: 期待繼續這段旅程。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
